name: Elrond
subtitle: Herald to Gil-galad
game_text:
At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 and heal that ally up to 2 times.
<phase>Regroup</phase>: Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.
flavor_text: “Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....”
